main_text.p: tim, sed ad utrumq; simul pertinentę, exponemus. Prius caput his fere constat uerbis: QVI TESTAMENTVM FACIET, IS OMNEM VIRILIS SEXVS, QVI EI SVVS HERES FVTVRVS ERIT CVM NASCETVR, NOMINATIM VEL HEREDEM VEL EXHEREDEM FACITO: IS QVE RECTE VEL INSTITV-TVS, VEL EXHEREDATVS ESTO, ETIAMSI PARENTE VIVO NASÇA[?]-TVR. Quorum uerborum hæc sententia est, quemadmodum qui nobis post mortem nostram suí nascentes, si hæredes ab nobis ex Aquiliana formula instituti, exheredatiue sint, testamentum non rumpunt: quippe qui præte-riti non reperiuntur; similiter Vellea lex voluit, eos qui post testamentum nostrum, nobis adhuc vivientibus suí nascerentur, si vel heredes, vel exheredes ab nobis facti essent, testamentum non rumpere. veluti, cum filius meus mortuus uxorem suam gravidam reliquisset, ita scripsi: QVICVNQVE VIRILIS SEXVS MIHI SVVS HERES RES

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the lower right, so the last word of the page is read as "RES" alone and may be the start of a longer word continued on the next page. The word NASÇA with its cedilla and the hyphenated break NASÇA-TVR are uncertain and marked [?]. Printed ç and ę are kept as they appear. Long s is normalised to s, and u/v and i/j are normalised as required. The paragraph is treated as continuing across the whole page, since no indent or short line ends a paragraph here. The hyphens at "INSTITV-TVS" and "præte-riti" are printed line-end hyphens, and they are kept.
